content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly remuneration is Rs. 95,000/- per month for Medical Officer and Rs. 36,500/- per month for Lab Assistant. The appointment is engagement on a contractual basis at ECHS Polyclinic Shahpur, Distt. Kangra for a period of one year for ESM and 11 months for civil candidates, renewable for an additional period of one year or until attaining the maximum age limit subject to performance of candidates and other conditions.

content_sections.heading: ECHS Dharamsala Medical Officer Job Description
content_sections.text: Provide medical and healthcare services at ECHS Polyclinic Shahpur, Distt. Kangra. Perform laboratory tests and support medical diagnostics for Lab Assistant role.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ECHS Dharamsala Medical Officer
content_sections.text: Download or obtain the application form from www.echs.gov.in. Fill out the application in duplicate on the prescribed format. Attach self-attested photocopies of testimonials supporting educational qualifications, work experiences, discharge book, PPO, service records, and a passport-size color photograph at the time of interview (or submission). Submit the application in duplicate to OIC, Station HQ (ECHS Cell) Dharamsala either in person or by post. Ensure the application reaches Station HQ Dharamsala by 1200 hrs on 24 October 2026. Attend the interview at Station HQ Dharamsala at 0900 hrs on 30 October 2026 along with all original certificates, mark sheets, degrees, work experience, medical fitness certificate, and character certificate signed by CMO/SEMO.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Educational certificates and mark sheets (10th, Matric, 10+2, Graduation, Post Graduation, Diploma/Course) Work Experience certificates Medical Fitness Certificate (duly signed by CMO/SEMO) Character Certificate (duly signed by CMO/SEMO) Discharge Book PPO Service Records Passport-size color photographs

content_sections.heading: ECHS Dharamsala Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after 1200 hrs on 24 October 2026 will not be accepted for any records. Preference will be given to Ex-servicemen, widow of service personnel, and Veer Naris. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Only candidates meeting the qualitative requirement may attend and will be called for interview. Original certificates, mark sheets, degrees, and certificates must be brought on the day of interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is ECHS Dharamsala Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ECHS Dharamsala recruitment is an employment notice seeking applications for Medical Officer and Lab Assistant posts on a contract basis at ECHS Polyclinic Shahpur, District Kangra.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available, comprising 2 vacancies for Medical Officer and 1 vacancy for Lab Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit offline applications is 24 October 2026 up to 1200 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a basic qualification (MBBS) with a minimum of 3 years of experience after internship. Preferred additional qualifications include Medicine/Surgery.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The age limit for Medical Officer is 66 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Lab Assistant?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration for Lab Assistant is Rs. 36,500/-.

faq.question: Q7. Is the job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The posts are on a contract basis for a period of one year for Ex-Servicemen and 11 months for civil candidates, renewable for an additional year or until attaining the maximum age limit.

faq.question: Q8. When and where is the interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The interview will be held on 30 October 2026 at 0900 hrs at Station HQ Dharamsala.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.
